text:
Maria: Quick sync 0min 0need final copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing tiles + CTA routing and a short benchmark line for the hero band. Also want a webinar RSVP included in the hero. Ideas?

Kevin: Agree on separate CTAs per offering. Suggested priorities: Hosted = fastest time-to-value, Dedicated = predictable throughput & SLAs, Private = security/compliance. Keep hero headline tight, follow with one-line value bands under each tile.

Sophie: Wrote two hero options:
  Variant 1 (PLG tone): "Ship LLM features that stay fast and affordable in production." 
    subhead: "One API. Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments."
  Variant 2 (enterprise tone): "Production-grade LLM inference for mission-critical apps."
    subhead: "Hosted for rapid experimentation. Dedicated for throughput. Private for compliance."
  Which direction?

Ryan: For bench blurb: "Benchmarks: [model] on 8k context — p99 60ms on Dedicated; up to 40% unit-cost reduction with caching + quantization." Link to full benchmarks page. Also recommend small line above CTAs: "See full benchmarks or RSVP for the launch webinar." Webinar modal should set utm_campaign=webinar_launch.

Dan: Routing options: path-based redirects are cleaner for analytics (`/cta/hosted`, `/cta/dedicated`, `/cta/private`) or query-based like `/signup?plan=hosted&utm_campaign=launch_q2`. We can implement nginx rules or Webflow redirects. Server fallback recommended for non-JS.

Jules: I can wire Webflow to use path-based redirects and add an A/B test for the hero variants via cookie. Need copy freeze by Friday EOD to hit next-week deploy.

Maria: Tasking: Kevin finalize microcopy per tile; Sophie finalize art and alt text; Ryan build webinar landing & confirm UTMs; Jules set up redirects + A/B; Dan add server fallback redirect & a short test route.

Kevin: Draft CTAs: Hosted = "Start free"; Dedicated = "Get pricing"; Private = "Talk to sales". Aligns with funnel stage?

Sophie: Prefer those CTAs, less salesy. Also recommend the Dedicated tile include a one-line SLA mention: "SLA-backed latency targets."

Maria: Use Sophie's CTAs. Kevin drop final microcopy into the shared doc and tag folks. Ryan, once webinar page is live, post link here and I'll add to the hero band.

Ryan: Webinar URL will include `?utm_source=site&utm_medium=hero&utm_campaign=webinar_launch`. Will post link when ready.

Dan: Example nginx snippet if useful:
```
location = /cta/hosted { return 302 /signup?plan=hosted&utm_source=site&utm_campaign=launch_q2; }
location = /cta/dedicated { return 302 /contact?plan=dedicated&utm_source=site&utm_campaign=launch_q2; }
location = /cta/private { return 302 /contact?plan=private&utm_source=site&utm_campaign=launch_q2; }
```

Jules: I'll queue the A/B test and run a quick QA pass in staging after copy freeze. Will flag any layout regressions.

Maria: Copy freeze Friday EOD. Ping here when each task is done. :rocket:

Kevin: Updated the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketing/landing-copy-v4. Added microcopy for each tile and the hero band sentence.

Sophie: Uploaded hero comps to the design system and added alt text.

Ryan: Webinar signup is live (staging) at https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-launch?utm_source=site&utm_campaign=webinar_launch. Posting final link when production is up.

Dan: Added test routes to staging and a non-JS redirect fallback.

Jules: Staging build up with copy + A/B test flag. Will run QA Monday morning.

Maria: Thanks team. Goal: go-live next Wednesday. If blockers, escalate here. :thumbsup:
